description: del portal de la bicicleta (spainbybike.es) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms-spainbybike.idee.es. It contains the geographical information corresponding to the cycling stages contained in the portal of cycling routes through Spain spainbybike.es. In addition, it contains mountain ports and BTT spaces (All Terrain Bike). Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle Portal WMS (spainbybike.es)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Rutas, Etapa, Bicicleta, BTT. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
